coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit both .SRCINFO and PKGBUILD due to HTTP 400 BadRequestError, resulting in an inconclusive verdict and triggering an unnecessary escalation.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback models for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent transient tool failures from triggering unnecessary escalation audits.
Ensure the audit tool correctly handles API error responses by either retrying or failing gracefully, rather than marking files as 'inconclusive' and polluting the verdict aggregation.
